Select distinct IC50 activity records for compounds tested against human interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, and target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on record_id to obtain compound_key. Join docs on doc_id to obtain pubmed_id or doi. Filter by target name 'interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4' and target organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
